body:
Dear, Reader

Previously when the server was called ''McTheWalls'' i played it so much but when the update avic.us came out i just stopped playing, so a few days earlier i found the server back so i thought Whuuuut is this server still alive . . . i started up my Minecraft and it Disconnected me. i got banned because i used fly, kill aura, anti-knockback But i needs to be a Mistake I never hacked on this server before! 
if someone can pls unban me that would be great and then i could enjoy nebula again

- FreakyRatSlammer
